text:
Philippines 🇵🇭: Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF) members posted videos from the Bangsamoro region showing off two US made Mk 14 Mod 0 EBR rifles.

The rifles are fitted with Sage EBR chassis, camo wraps and Discovery MS scopes. https://t.co/MlfX5kzf86

Israel's Rafael has unveiled Super Ice, a long range cruise missile with a 1,000 pound warhead that can be fired from jets, ships or ground launchers.

Its range is undisclosed. Rafael's earlier Ice Breaker carried a 250 pound warhead up to 300 km.

Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi says Marco Rubio is repeating Mike Pompeo's 2018 line that Iranians must obey the White House "if they want to eat".

He says Rubio's fellow Cubans suffer the same policy and blames US "delusions" for its failure.

🚨 Iran has designated Argentina's navy and air force as terrorist organizations, its Foreign Ministry says.

Tehran calls it a reciprocal move after Argentina listed the IRGC as a terrorist group in April, and says Buenos Aires is responsible for any consequences.

Ukraine's drone strikes on Russian refineries could cut Russia's crude processing by up to 200,000 tonnes a day, or 73 million tonnes a year, industry sources told Reuters.

Nine of Russia's 35 major refineries have been disrupted, including Ryazan and Kirishi.

Twelve US senators led by Chris Van Hollen, including Bernie Sanders and Elizabeth Warren, urge Congress to drop 2027 defense bill provisions mandating closer military tech and intelligence ties with Israel.

One would bar any cut in intel sharing.

Ukraine says it has captured its first Indonesian prisoner of war, a 49 year old from Java sent to fight for Russia in Zaporizhzhia.

Kyiv says Russia recruited 283 Indonesians in nine months this year, against 10 at most in the prior three years.

Follow up: Yemen's Saudi backed government forces say strikes across six provinces killed or wounded about 190 Houthi fighters.

The Houthis say they also inflicted heavy losses on government troops in Lahij and Al Jawf.

Top Trump aides are clashing over how to bring the war with Iran to an end, and the administration is weighing its options.

On the table are escalation, narrower strikes or a push for diplomacy, and none of them is an easy choice.

Satellite thermal imagery is said to show a second ship burning in the Strait of Hormuz right now.

It follows an earlier fire spotted in the strait this morning. The vessel's name and the cause of the fire have not been confirmed. https://t.co/6La47cG6zD

Myanmar 🇲🇲: People's Defense Forces fighters hit a building said to be housing Burmese soldiers with an FPV kamikaze drone.

The drone was very likely armed with a locally made high explosive warhead. https://t.co/QUY4p3RDmy

Video shows a ship partly sunk in the Strait of Hormuz, with only its superstructure still above the water.

It is described as a vessel that violated Iran's rules for the strait and was targeted. Its name and when it sank have not been confirmed. https://t.co/uPiB7AfKJm

The US embassy in Riyadh is telling Americans in Saudi Arabia and across the Middle East to be extra vigilant.

It warns of threats from the Iran backed Houthis and of alleged Iranian efforts to target US government officials.

Follow up: Eleven Democrats missed the House vote on the resolution to impeach War Secretary Pete Hegseth.

It was sent to committee by 211 to 204, a margin their votes could have changed.
Oil prices rose from a two month low as attacks on shipping in the Strait of Hormuz outweighed hopes for a truce in the Iran war.

Israel's opposition, which now holds a majority in the new Knesset under Gadi Eisenkot, is pressing for an official inquiry into the October 7 attack as parliament opens its first session.

Dozens of new lawmakers took their oath of office.
Democrats plan to use the upcoming government funding negotiations to try to cut off money for the US and Israeli war on Iran, Senator Adam Schiff says.

🚨 UKMTO warning 202/26: a tanker has been involved in an incident in the Strait of Hormuz, military authorities report.

The condition of the crew, any damage and the environmental impact remain unknown. Vessels are advised to transit with caution. https://t.co/rtjtiflOVi
Iran's military has opened a training centre at Tehran's Azadi Square where women learn self defence, from sniper rifles to ziplines, as the conflict with the United States continues.

🚨 At least three people have been killed and three others critically injured after a vehicle struck pedestrians near a Metro station in North Hollywood, Los Angeles, the city fire department says.

Police are investigating the crash. https://t.co/BfVNFc158j
